units.text: proceeding from the universally recognized principles of the equality and self-determination of peoples,

units.label: Beginning of document · “honouring the memory of our ancestors, who passed on to us love…”

units.text: Section I
units.label: Section I

units.text: SECTION ONE
units.label: SECTION ONE

units.locator: CHAPTER 1. FOUNDATIONS OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL ORDER
units.text: CHAPTER 1. FOUNDATIONS OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL ORDER
units.label: CHAPTER 1. FOUNDATIONS OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL ORDER

units.text: Article 1
units.label: Art. 1

units.text: 1. The Russian Federation — Russia is a democratic federal State governed by the rule of law, with a republican form of government.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1

units.text: 2. The names Russian Federation and Russia are equivalent.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1

units.text: Article 2
units.label: Art. 2

units.text: The individual and their rights and freedoms are the highest value. Recognition, observance and protection of human and civil rights and freedoms are the duty of the State.
units.label: Art. 2 · text

units.text: Article 3
units.label: Art. 3

units.text: 1. The bearer of sovereignty and the sole source of power in the Russian Federation is its multinational people.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3

units.text: 2. The people exercise their power directly and also through bodies of state authority and local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3

units.text: 3. The supreme direct expression of the power of the people is the referendum and free elections.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3

units.text: 4. No one may appropriate power in the Russian Federation. Seizure of power or appropriation of powers of authority is punishable under federal law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 3

units.text: Article 4
units.label: Art. 4

units.text: 1. The sovereignty of the Russian Federation extends throughout its territory.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4

units.text: 2. The Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws have supremacy throughout the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4

units.text: 3. The Russian Federation ensures the integrity and inviolability of its territory.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 4

units.text: Article 5
units.label: Art. 5

units.text: 1. The Russian Federation consists of republics, territories, regions, cities of federal significance, an autonomous region and autonomous areas — equal constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 5

units.text: 2. A republic (State) has its own constitution and legislation. A territory, region, city of federal significance, autonomous region or autonomous area has its own charter and legislation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 5

units.text: 3. The federal structure of the Russian Federation is based on its state integrity, the unity of the system of state authority, the delimitation of matters of jurisdiction and powers between bodies of state authority of the Russian Federation and bodies of state authority of its constituent entities, and the equality and self-determination of peoples in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 5

units.text: 4. In their relations with federal bodies of state authority, all constituent entities of the Russian Federation are equal to one another.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 5

units.text: Article 6
units.label: Art. 6

units.text: 1. Citizenship of the Russian Federation is acquired and terminated in accordance with federal law and is single and equal, irrespective of the grounds for its acquisition.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 6

units.text: 2. Every citizen of the Russian Federation possesses in its territory all rights and freedoms and bears the equal duties provided for by the Constitution of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 6

units.text: 3. A citizen of the Russian Federation may not be deprived of citizenship or of the right to change it.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 6

units.text: Article 7
units.label: Art. 7

units.text: 1. The Russian Federation is a social State whose policy is directed towards creating conditions that ensure a dignified life and the free development of the individual.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7

units.text: 2. In the Russian Federation, people's labour and health are protected, a guaranteed minimum wage is established, state support is provided for the family, motherhood, fatherhood and childhood, persons with disabilities and older citizens, a system of social services is developed, and state pensions, benefits and other guarantees of social protection are established.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7

units.text: Article 8
units.label: Art. 8

units.text: 1. In the Russian Federation, the unity of the economic space, the free movement of goods, services and financial resources, support for competition and freedom of economic activity are guaranteed.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8

units.text: 2. Private, state, municipal and other forms of ownership are recognized and protected equally in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8

units.text: Article 9
units.label: Art. 9

units.text: 1. Land and other natural resources are used and protected in the Russian Federation as the basis of the life and activity of the peoples living in the relevant territory.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 9

units.text: 2. Land and other natural resources may be held in private, state, municipal and other forms of ownership.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 9

units.text: Article 10
units.label: Art. 10

units.text: State power in the Russian Federation is exercised on the basis of its separation into legislative, executive and judicial powers. Legislative, executive and judicial bodies are independent.
units.label: Art. 10 · text

units.text: Article 11
units.label: Art. 11

units.text: 1. State power in the Russian Federation is exercised by the President of the Russian Federation, the Federal Assembly (the Federation Council and the State Duma), the Government of the Russian Federation and the courts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11

units.text: 2. State power in the constituent entities of the Russian Federation is exercised by the bodies of state authority established by them.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11

units.text: 3. Matters of jurisdiction and powers are delimited between bodies of state authority of the Russian Federation and bodies of state authority of its constituent entities by this Constitution, the Federation Treaty and other treaties delimiting matters of jurisdiction and powers.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 11

units.text: Article 12
units.label: Art. 12

units.text: Local self-government is recognized and guaranteed in the Russian Federation. Local self-government is independent within the limits of its powers. Local self-government bodies do not form part of the system of bodies of state authority.
units.label: Art. 12 · text

units.text: Article 13
units.label: Art. 13

units.text: 1. Ideological diversity is recognized in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13

units.text: 2. No ideology may be established as a state or mandatory ideology.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13

units.text: 3. Political diversity and a multiparty system are recognized in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13

units.text: 4. Public associations are equal before the law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13

units.text: 5. The establishment and activities of public associations whose aims or actions are directed at forcibly changing the foundations of the constitutional order, violating the integrity of the Russian Federation, undermining state security, creating armed formations or inciting social, racial, ethnic or religious strife are prohibited.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 13
